text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly overcoming a field of fierce 
rivals! The one crowned Queen of the 
Cherry Blossoms is—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin Racecourse is trembling with 
cheers of celebration!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't reach it...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I am so sorry, Trainer...
choice_data_list: No, but it was still a great race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is by no means mere consolation. It 
was a wonderful race where Cesario gave it 
everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I see. Even so, I still—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone—especially Craft. As expected, 
that was a terrifying burst of speed."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Her next race, the Yushun Himba (Oaks)—or 
perhaps even beyond that. She will surely 
stand in our way."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Maintaining the status quo won't be 
enough to compete. Let us devise a 
strategy and establish a clear direction."
choice_data_list:
Yeah...! Let's do our best in the next 
Oaks, too!

Yeah...! Let's do our best at the next 
one, the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No... with my Trainer, and with my rivals. 
I was just thinking how truly blessed I 
am.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Whoa...! Cesario-san and Craft-san, 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That was quite something, the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I really should have gone to see it in 
person! What a missed opportunity...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I agree―― Especially her――Cesario's 
race."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Her technique is, of courseâ An 
overwhelming... fighting spirit. An 
obsession with "victory"â

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Truly—an extraordinary talent. —A 
one-in-a-million talent.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, I totally get it! What amazing 
potential~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... If it's her, perhaps— To the 
point where I couldn't help wishing so.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wish... you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes— A revolution—in the Japanese 
Umamusume world... In other words—the 
power—to take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I found myself dreaming of such a wish... 
With Cesario...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Selfish expectations.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
............ Hehe, no, it's great, isn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Entrusting our dreams and hopes to the 
active members. That is our important job 
right now♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The stars of this year's "Oka Sho" are 
Rhein Kraft and Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With such memories etched in mind, the 
spring stage drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho was really fun.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! Cesario, Heart-san, 
Messiah-san... everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! I've decided! No more looking 
back!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I have to go... toward my own path...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks)— the crown of the Queen of the Oaks 
that she has desired most of all.
